principle_violations.reason: The UserService class is responsible for both user management and data storage, violating the Single Responsibility Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Extract the database operations into a separate class or interface to ensure that UserService only manages users and delegates database operations to another component.

principle_violations.reason: UserService directly depends on MySQLDatabase, which violates the Dependency Inversion Principle since high-level modules should not depend on low-level modules.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce an interface (e.g., Database) that MySQLDatabase implements. UserService should depend on this interface instead of a specific database implementation.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details above.
